title: Traditional Jaffna Cuisine
description: Preserving authentic Northern Sri Lankan recipes, palmyra delicacies, and traditional clay-pot cooking secrets passed down through generations.

title: Kandyan Dance Traditions
description: Celebrating Ves dance rituals, drum rhythms, sacred temple dances, and the rich dance heritage of the Hill Country.

title: Village Folk Songs
description: Preserving paddy harvest chants, lullabies, boating songs, and oral folklore melodies sung across rural Sri Lankan villages.

title: Northern Heritage & Living History
description: Explore Jaffna temples, historic homes, inscriptions, local landmarks and the memories elders carry about how their communities changed over time.

title: Tamil Dialects & Oral Expressions
description: Collect regional words, sayings, pronunciation and everyday expressions, with elders explaining when and where each phrase is used.

title: Home Gardens & Traditional Healing
description: Document traditional home-garden plants, preparation customs and family knowledge. Shared knowledge is for cultural learning, not medical advice.
